overview_description.description: Aleph is a financial software company that provides AI-native financial planning and analysis tools and data management infrastructure. The company's platform helps finance teams consolidate data from multiple systems—ERP, HRIS, CRM, etc.—using over 150 no-code connectors, enabling real-time syncing and automated transformations so that data becomes clean, reliable, and ready-to-use. Its key offerings include automated financial reporting & closing, collaborative budgeting and forecasting, modeling, investor/board reporting, and headcount planning—all intended to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and scale output without scaling headcount. Aleph supports existing workflows by integrating with Excel and Google Sheets via add-ins so teams can keep using their familiar reporting tools while benefiting from automation, variance analysis, and live data dashboards.

about_short_description.short_description: Aleph is a financial software company that provides AI-native financial planning and analysis tools and data management infrastructure.

product.name: Connect & Sync
product.description: A platform feature that integrates and synchronizes data from over 150 systems including ERP, HRIS, and CRM in real time without coding.

product.name: Consolidate & Transform
product.description: A data processing tool that cleans, maps, combines, and calculates financial data to prepare it for analysis.

product.name: Automate & Analyze
product.description: A feature that integrates with Excel and Google Sheets to sync data bi-directionally and uses AI to detect and explain financial variances automatically.

product.name: Visualize & Share
product.description: A dashboard and visualization tool that creates interactive reports and shares key financial metrics and trends across the organization.

product.name: Financial Reporting & Close
product.description: A solution that automates routine financial reporting and closing processes, reducing multi-day tasks to simple operations.

product.name: Collaborative Budgeting
product.description: A budgeting tool that facilitates collaborative budget planning and tracking, enabling budget owners to update and monitor their budgets actively.
